Demdemeh
Clan: Tzimisce (group 4)
Capacity: 10
Disciplines: ANI CEL FOR VIC aus pre
Laibon: If any Gehenna cards are in play during your untap phase, you
may move an animal retainer on Demdemeh to your ready region as an
animal ally with 1 strength and 1 bleed. While that animal has more
than 2 life, he or she gets +1 strength.

While the animal retainer may or may not have originally required
Animalism to bring into play, Demdemeh converts it to an animal ally
with card text (special). The special text "wipes" the old card clean
and creates a new card - an animal ally with 1 strength and 1 bleed,
and an additional +1 strength if it has 3 or more life.

The new Animal Ally did not require Animalism to bring into play.
